name: memo_write
description: Saves a text note on this server and returns its id. Find it again with memo_search. It does not edit or delete notes.

text.description: The note, as plain text, 1 to 20,000 characters. Example: "Meeting moved to 14:00."

id.description: Id of the saved note, such as memo_hLpsXpI7o8ix8iar.

created_at.description: When it was saved, in UTC.

name: memo_search
description: Finds saved notes that contain every word of the query, newest first; an empty query returns the newest notes. The result stays under 1 kB: older matches are left out (omitted counts them) and one very long note is clipped (truncated), and hint says how to narrow the search.

query.description: Words to look for, case-insensitive; a note matches when it holds every word. Empty matches every note. Example: "meeting 14:00".

limit.description: Most notes to return, from 1 to 100. Default 20. Fewer come back when they would not fit 1 kB.

text.description: The note text, or its start when truncated is true.

created_at.description: When it was saved, in UTC.

source.description: Name of the client that saved it.

truncated.description: Only when the text was clipped to fit 1 kB.

omitted.description: Only when older matching notes were left out to fit 1 kB: how many.

hint.description: Only when notes were left out or clipped: how to see the rest.

name: upload
description: Gives a link for a file to store on this server: PUT the file's raw bytes to upload_url, then share url, which anyone can open without signing in. The file itself never goes through the tool call.

filename.description: File name with its extension, such as notes.txt or clip.mp3. It ends the link, and sets the type when content_type is left out.

content_type.description: MIME type, such as text/plain or audio/mpeg. Guessed from the file name when left out.

url.description: Public link to the file on this server. It works once the PUT returns 200; anyone with it can open it.

upload_url.description: Send the raw bytes here with one HTTP PUT, no sign-in header, once, up to 25 MB.

expires_at.description: When upload_url stops working, 15 minutes after this call.

name: transcribe
description: Turns speech in an audio file at a public link into text segments, each with its start in seconds (Whisper). When the transcript does not fit 1 kB, the result holds the first segments and a link to the whole transcript. It does not translate.

url.description: Public http or https link to an audio file (mp3, wav, m4a, ogg, flac or webm), up to 25 MB, not on a private network. Example: https://example.com/talk.mp3.

segments.description: What was said, in order; only the first ones when omitted is set.

start.description: Seconds from the start of the audio, rounded to 0.01.

text.description: What was said from that point.

omitted.description: Only when the transcript did not fit 1 kB: how many later segments are left out.

transcript_url.description: Only with omitted: public link to the whole transcript as text, one line per segment, "[start] text".

transcript_bytes.description: Only with omitted: size of that text in bytes.
